'''Telbus''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He spoke a [[Language/Legends|language]] other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].

==Biography==
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Telbus and his [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned acolyte were present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]] where they tried to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Slider (individual)|Slider]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] working for [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]]. However, before they could get to him, the two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were beaten up by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|brawl]].<ref name="SW108" />
